name: Odalys Bautista
role: Personnel recovery and hostile extraction — extraction specialist
location: The Spires — mid-level corporate residential towers, near Michigan Ave and Oak
description:
Odalys Bautista is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 41, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. She works as a extraction specialist out of The Spires, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Odalys Bautista is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
psychology.secret: Tenzin Nakamura-Bello has a terminal condition — geneware degradation — with an estimated five years. They haven't changed their lifestyle. They haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "We go in, we get the asset, we leave. Everything else is improvisation."
"The extraction window is four minutes. I've done it in three."
"I don't rescue people. I relocate them aggressively."

story_hooks: Tenzin Nakamura-Bello intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A Tier 4 executive offers Tenzin Nakamura-Bello a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A corporate black site Tenzin Nakamura-Bello once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
narrative_function: Tenzin Nakamura-Bello is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Multi-continental diaspora: Hispanic/Latin American (39.5%), Sub-Saharan African (33.5%), Northern European (15.4%), and North African (11.6%). This genetic blend creates striking physical presence — warm, richly layered skin undertones with golden-honey and earthy depth. The combination produces defined facial architecture with balanced proportions: strong cheekbones from African and Latin heritage, refined bone structure and slight facial width from North African and Northern European ancestry, creating a uniquely sculpted appearance.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — dancer's precision combined with fighter's density. No excess weight; every kilogram serves function. Shoulders broad and squared from years of extraction work.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; practical for work, never loose
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle amber undertones
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep golden-brown with warm, honey-amber undertones shifting to earthy richness depending on light. Medium-deep saturation with natural luminosity reflecting the layered Sub-Saharan African, Latin American, North African, and Northern European heritage blend.
physical_description.complexion: Sculpted facial structure with strong, pronounced cheekbones and angular jawline — the African and Latin heritage creating definitive bone prominence, while North African and Northern European ancestry contributes refined upper-facial structure and cheek width. Natural facial symmetry with inherent architectural strength. Minimal makeup; skin shows work-related wear but excellent condition. A faint network of surgical scars visible around temples and along jawline where chrome integration sites remain slightly raised.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scarring along both temples in a precise geometric pattern where neural interface ports were installed — visible chrome edges catch light
Linear scarring along the right jawline extending toward ear, roughly 8cm long, where air filtration system was integrated
Small burn scar on left forearm (5cm diameter), pale against skin — old enough to have faded to white
Tattoo along inner left wrist: minimalist kanji (patience/perseverance), done in matte black ink
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome-framed neural interface ports at both temples with visible brushed titanium flanges; surgical scarring creates a deliberate, unflinching aesthetic. Internal air filtration system vents subtly visible at the base of her neck where synthetic lung integration meets biological tissue — a thin line of aerospace-grade composite material visible when she moves her head. No attempt to conceal these; they're worn like credentials.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise — never wasted motion. Stands with weight distributed for immediate movement in any direction. When moving through space, she's fluid but controlled, the way someone moves when they've trained to clear rooms and extract targets. Rarely still; fingers often drum patterns on surfaces or flex unconsciously. Her breathing is slightly audible at rest — a subtle mechanical whisper beneath natural respiration.
physical_description.clothing_style: Functional Tier-2 hybrid aesthetic — form-fitting synthetic fiber tactical pants in matte grey-black with reinforced seams and utility pockets; lightweight responsive-fabric compression shirt under a fitted, cropped jacket in charcoal with subtle reflective threading. High-grade boots (Aegis-brand, military-spec) with memory-foam soles for silent movement. Minimal jewelry except a worn stainless steel bracelet (likely sentimental from her mentor). When undercover in civilian life, she shifts to unmarked streetwear that still reads as 'prepared' — dark colors, functional silhouettes, nothing that draws attention but nothing that advertises vulnerability.
